description: Backend FC26 data layer: migration + apply script + types, central pricing, FC26 CSV importer/catalog/routes with env-configurable paths, Underdog draft_pool/player_tag, five pots (GK/CB/FB/MID/ATT), `playerPoolSource` and `retention.enabled` settings (saved + synced), FC26-source START_AUCTION pool, archive lookup by fc26_player_id. Independent of the frontend; FEAT-002 depends on it. See plan.md sections 2, 3 (D3-D6, D8-D10).
steps: Write supabase/migrations/20261001090000_fc26_database_retention.sql exactly as in plan D8 (additive, `if not exists`, football_players columns + checks + unique partial index on fc26_player_id, auction_rooms retention_enabled/player_pool_source, auction_retentions table with unique(room_id,player_id) and unique(room_id,fc26_player_id), RLS on, revoke anon/authenticated, grant service_role). Add backend/scripts/apply-fc26-schema.mjs modeled on backend/scripts/apply-cup-schema.mjs (dry run prints football_players/auction_rooms/auction_retentions columns and constraints; --apply runs the SQL, verifies RLS, registers the version). DO NOT run --apply. Hand-update supabase/types/database.types.ts and backend/src/types/database.generated.d.ts for the new columns/table.

Create backend/src/domain/pricing.ts (UNDERDOG 1 Cr, MEDIUM 3 Cr, TOP 5 Cr, TOP_RATING_THRESHOLD default 90, `fc26BasePriceUnits({overall, draftPool}, threshold)` returning toUnits(...)). Threshold comes from env FC26_TOP_RATING_THRESHOLD via config/env.ts and is passed in; no rating conditions anywhere else.

Add env vars FC26_DATA_DIR, FC26_CSV_GK, FC26_CSV_CB, FC26_CSV_FULLBACKS, FC26_CSV_MID, FC26_CSV_ATT, FC26_CSV_UNDERDOG, FC26_TOP_RATING_THRESHOLD to backend/src/config/env.ts (optional strings / bounded int), document in backend/.env.example and backend/ENVIRONMENT.md. Create backend/src/modules/fc26/fc26.config.ts: default dir = repo root resolved from import.meta.url (four levels up, valid for src and dist); Underdog candidates ['FC26_Underdog.csv','FC26_Underdogs.csv'].

Create backend/src/modules/fc26/fc26.positions.ts (`positionGroup` filter groups ALL/GK/CB/FB/CM/WM/ST/W, broad position mapping GK/DEF/MID/FWD, `assignPot` per plan D4) and fc26.importer.ts (reuse parseCsv from modules/players/player.service.ts after stripping a leading BOM; map columns per plan section 2; zod-validate rows; collect invalid rows with file/row/reason; missing/unreadable/malformed file reported not thrown; dedupe across files by player_id with Underdog winning, then the D4 rule; keep source_category and source_categories; store everything else under metadata.fc26; compute draft_pool/player_tag/base price).

Create backend/src/modules/fc26/fc26.catalog.ts: `Fc26Catalog` interface, `MemoryFc26Catalog`, `PostgresFc26Catalog` (insert ... on conflict (fc26_player_id) do nothing; external_id NULL; map 42703/42P01 to DomainError FC26_SCHEMA_MISSING 503 mentioning the migration; read rows back into Player-shaped objects with potId = auction_pot, id = fc26_player_id, externalId = fc26_player_id). Extend domain `Player` (types.ts) with optional draftPool, playerTag, sourceCategory, positions, potential, fullName; make sure publicPlayer (modules/teams/team.service.ts) passes them through. search() does a precomputed lowercase haystack (name, full name, club, nationality, id, positions), AND over tokens, group filter, sort ovr desc then name, offset/limit.

Create backend/src/modules/fc26/fc26.routes.ts: GET /api/fc26/status, POST /api/fc26/import (authenticated, rate limit 5/min, no client paths, returns the import report {filesRead, missingFiles, rowsRead, imported, skippedDuplicates, invalidRows, perFile, underdogImported}). Extend backend/src/modules/players/player.routes.ts with `source=FC26` using the catalog. Register in app.ts; pass the catalog as the new optional 6th RoomManager constructor argument (`manager.fc26`); in server.ts build PostgresFc26Catalog when managerDb exists (fall back to Memory with a logged warning on FC26_SCHEMA_MISSING) and run a non-fatal import at boot.

Settings: in backend/src/schemas/settings.ts add `playerPoolSource: z.enum(['DEFAULT','FC26']).default('DEFAULT')` and `retention: z.object({enabled: z.boolean().default(false)}).strict().default({})` to settingsShape; superRefine retention.enabled requires FC26; add exported `parseSettings(input)` that forces minimumBasePriceCr=1 for FC26 before parsing and use it in room.manager.ts `create`, room.service.ts `updateSettings` and auction.engine.ts `UPDATE_SETTINGS`. Reject creating/updating to FC26 with an empty catalog (FC26_CATALOG_EMPTY 409). Old snapshots (no new keys) must still hydrate.

auction.engine.ts START_AUCTION: when settings.playerPoolSource==='FC26' build the pool from manager.fc26.list() (recompute base price via pricing.ts, never trust stored values), no Math.max bump; DEFAULT path unchanged. Keep any pre-existing SOLD entries in room.players (needed by FEAT-002): `room.players = [...existing SOLD players, ...pool minus those ids]`.

manager-mode/completed-auction-archive.ts: extend the `known` query with `or fc26_player_id in (...)` and the `found` match so FC26 players reuse their master row (no duplicate football_players rows). Update backend/WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL.md/AUCTION_RULES.md briefly for the new settings and pots.

Tests: backend/tests/fixtures/fc26/ small CSVs (GK, CB, Fullbacks, Mid, ATT, Underdogs with BOM, a cross-file duplicate, an invalid row, a multi-position player) + backend/tests/fc26-import.test.ts and fc26-pricing.test.ts covering: all six files import; reimport imports 0 and skips all as duplicates; Underdog draft_pool/player_tag stored, regular null tag; position mapping and pot assignment (D4); primary/secondary positions; base prices 1/3/5 incl. underdog 90+ => 1 Cr and threshold override; missing file and malformed file do not throw and are reported; real repo CSVs (skip if absent): 250 rows read, 206 imported, 44 duplicates, 30 underdogs; START_AUCTION with FC26 source puts underdogs in the same pots as regular players and exposes basePriceCr 1/3/5; old settings still parse. Extend tests/helpers.ts `fixture()` with an optional `fc26` catalog argument.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend; npx vitest run tests/fc26-import.test.ts tests/fc26-pricing.test.ts` passes
`cd backend; npx vitest run` shows only the 6 pre-existing failures (skip-vote.test.ts x5, integration.test.ts x1)
Importing the six real repo CSVs yields 206 unique players, 44 skipped duplicates, 0 crashes; a second import yields imported=0
Underdog players are in pots GK/CB/FB/MID/ATT by primary position, have draft_pool=UNDERDOG and player_tag=UNDERDOG, base price 1 Cr; regular Top (>=90) 5 Cr, other regular 3 Cr
A room with default settings and DEFAULT source behaves exactly as before (existing auction tests unchanged and passing)
Migration file and apply script exist; migration NOT applied to any database
verification: cd backend; npx vitest run tests/fc26-import.test.ts tests/fc26-pricing.test.ts
cd backend; npx vitest run (only the 6 baseline failures allowed)
findings:
Verification: backend tsc --noEmit exit 0; vitest tests/fc26-import.test.ts + tests/fc26-pricing.test.ts = 23/23 pass (incl. real repo CSVs: 6 files, 250 rows, 206 imported, 44 duplicates, 30 underdogs, 0 invalid; reimport imported=0); full vitest = 222 pass / 6 fail (only baseline: skip-vote x5, integration skip-voting x1). manager-mode.test.ts 'automatically completes seasons' timed out once under full-suite load, passes alone and on rerun (flaky, unrelated).
Migration supabase/migrations/20261001090000_fc26_database_retention.sql + backend/scripts/apply-fc26-schema.mjs written; NOT applied, script not run. Types hand-updated in supabase/types/database.types.ts and backend/src/types/database.generated.d.ts (football_players cols, auction_rooms retention_enabled/player_pool_source, auction_retentions table).
Exports for later steps: domain/pricing.ts {UNDERDOG_BASE_PRICE_CR, MEDIUM_BASE_PRICE_CR, TOP_BASE_PRICE_CR, DEFAULT_TOP_RATING_THRESHOLD, DraftPool, fc26BasePriceUnits({overall,draftPool}, threshold)}. schemas/settings.ts adds playerPoolSource, retention:{enabled}, parseSettings(). modules/fc26/fc26.config.ts {resolveFc26Config(env, exists?), defaultFc26Dir, Fc26SourceCategory}. fc26.positions.ts {assignPot, potForPosition, broadPosition, matchesPositionGroup, POSITION_GROUPS, PositionGroup, FC26_POTS}. fc26.importer.ts {readFc26Files, buildFc26Records, buildFc26Report, Fc26ImportReport}. fc26.catalog.ts {Fc26Catalog (topRatingThreshold, importAll, list, get, search({query,group,potId,offset,limit,excludeIds}) -> {total,players}, stats, lastReport), MemoryFc26Catalog(config, readFile?), PostgresFc26Catalog(sql, config, readFile?)}. fc26.routes.ts registerFc26Routes(app, catalog). registerPlayerRoutes(app, players, fc26?) supports source=FC26.
RoomManager 6th ctor arg is `fc26?: Fc26Catalog` (manager.fc26) and new method manager.assertPoolSource(settings) (FC26_CATALOG_EMPTY 409). buildApp option `fc26`. tests/helpers.ts fixture(settings, repository, playerCount, fc26?) 4th arg; tests build a catalog with new MemoryFc26Catalog(resolveFc26Config({FC26_DATA_DIR: tests/fixtures/fc26})) then await importAll().
Player (domain/types.ts) gained optional fullName, potential, positions, draftPool, playerTag ('UNDERDOG'), sourceCategory, sourceCategories; publicPlayer passes them through. Catalog Player.id == FC26 player_id string; potId in GK/CB/FB/MID/ATT; basePriceUnits recomputed on load (never trusted).
START_AUCTION FC26 branch: room.players = [existing SOLD players kept, ...catalog pool minus those ids as WAITING with recomputed prices]; playerPoolConfig.playerIds/potIds filters applied; no retention gating yet (FEAT-002 adds RETENTION_NOT_FINALIZED). Default path unchanged.
Deviations/notes: archive lookup by fc26_player_id is only queried for rooms with playerPoolSource==='FC26' so default archiving does not depend on the unapplied migration. Unknown Underdog file name handled: FC26_Underdog.csv then FC26_Underdogs.csv. Boot import in server.ts is non-fatal and falls back to MemoryFc26Catalog on any failure (FC26_SCHEMA_MISSING logged). Report per-file rows are 1-based spreadsheet rows (header = row 1). skippedDuplicates on re-import = all valid rows (17 in fixtures). Test fixtures: backend/tests/fixtures/fc26 (18 rows, 14 unique, 1 invalid ATT row 5, BOM on Underdogs). Real CSVs left untracked/uncommitted; .agents/ left untracked.
Not done by design: no settings lock/retention logic, no retention players route, no RetentionLedger (FEAT-002); no frontend (FEAT-003).
